mia: quick flag 1min 0--- small burst of bench flakiness on recent 8-bit uploads. thinking we add a deterministic tokenizer-lint at admit + async golden-suite preflight. keep admit fast.
arjun: can repro; tokenizer normalization differences cause kv miss deltas. quick-lint should run on a 12-string canonical set. fail-fast on any mismatch.
zack: agree. implement quick-lint as a hermetic container that only reads descriptor uri + tokenizer manifest. return pass/fail and short reason. keep registry descriptor tiny (tokenizer_hash, tokenizer_manifest_uri, canonical_bundle_uri).
mia: what about post-admit failures?
arjun: async preflight -> if fails, auto-quarantine model to canary pool, notify owner, and rollback traffic to prev pinned model. console shows preflight status + logs.
onboard-bot: admit job 75512 started: quick-lint -> running.
zack: metrics: tokenizer_determinism_pct, kv_hit_delta_pct, async_preflight_status. set alert if kv delta > 0.4% or determinism mismatch > 1 in 24h.
mia: volunteers: arjun quick-lint, zack registry descriptor + dashboards, i'll wire quarantined routing and runbook. 1-week spike sprint. sync tomorrow 9:30.
